Subject: Re: Pemberly Table & Tap - New Submission

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Pemberly Table & Tap! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I do have a few questions before I can finalize terms:

- Can you confirm the primary cuisine type and whether they have any deep fryers or wood-fired cooking equipment?
- What are the hours of operation for each location?
- Is there any entertainment (live music, DJs, etc.) at either location?
- Can you provide details on their liquor liability limits preference?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 12/22/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
